## Code and notebooks

- [R: score invented structured extractions](examples/r/evaluate_extraction.R)
- [Python: score the same invented extractions](examples/python/evaluate_extraction.py)
- [marimo: explore scaled dot-product attention](notebooks/01-attention.py)
- [marimo: explore subgroup evaluation](notebooks/02-evaluation.py)

The book is static. Download `.py` files and run marimo locally as described in [Setup](setup.qmd). Example labels, notes, and predictions are invented; these scripts **do not call a model API**. R examples are the primary course language; Python examples illustrate parallel concepts.

## Primary sources and tools

- [Proposed course syllabus (PDF)](docs/AI_LLM_Healthcare_Syllabus_Proposal_Spring2027_R.pdf) — authoritative for the proposed schedule, policies, and readings, until superseded by the approved Canvas syllabus.
- [Keydana, *Deep Learning and Scientific Computing with R torch*](https://skeydan.github.io/Deep-Learning-and-Scientific-Computing-with-R-torch/)
- [Posit ellmer](https://ellmer.tidyverse.org/) · [ragnar](https://ragnar.tidyverse.org/) · [vitals](https://vitals.tidyverse.org/) · [mcptools](https://posit-dev.github.io/mcptools/) · [shinychat](https://posit-dev.github.io/shinychat/)
- [Quarto](https://quarto.org/docs/books/) · [marimo](https://docs.marimo.io/)

Package APIs, reading links, provider requirements and permissions should be checked again before the Spring 2027 course opens. No patient data or instructor-only materials are included here.
